listings.rawTitle: CASH FLOWER EXTRAIT DE PARFUM Extrait de Parfum Unisex 100 ml

And finally, in the base, there is a hint of musk and sandalwood."A fragrance for those who appreciate the finest pleasures of life. It evokes a feeling of richness, elegance and grace. listings.rawTitle: ANGEL DUST EXTRAIT DE PARFUM Extrait de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: The calming and peaceful notes of Angel Dust blend together to celebrate the gentle, introverted side in all of us. Yet this delicate, and strong perfume is composed around the mystical notes of Cashmeran; the 'polite molecule' notorious for its intimacy and closeness to the body. It is for the quiet, confident person in the room who doesn't need to attract attention, but simply attracts it. Angel Dust envelops us with comfort and lightness thanks to subtle notes of Calabrian bergamot, pink pepper, cashmere wood and white amber crystals.“Isn’t it illegal to smell that good in a work meeting? Why can’t I concentrate on work when she is sitting on the other side of the room even. I never even looked at her this way, but this scent is addictive. It’s adventurous. She smells like red lingerie. I really need to focus on my powerpoint.” – Bram Niessink, Founder
